description: This file defines the IntegrationConfiguration class, which models the configuration details for external gateway integrations within the sales management system. It includes properties like module code, environment, activation status, and related keys and options, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: IntegrationConfiguration
classes.description: Models the configuration of an external integration, including environment, activation status, keys, options, and JSON serialization behaviors.

methods.name: getModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the module code of the integration configuration.

methods.name: setModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the module code of the integration configuration.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the integration is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the integration.

methods.name: getIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the map of integration keys.

methods.name: setIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Sets the map of integration keys.

methods.name: getJsonInfo
methods.description: Builds and returns a JSON string of core configuration info.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts the entire configuration object into a JSON-formatted string.

methods.name: setEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the deployment environment (e.g., TEST or PRODUCTION).

methods.name: getIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Gets the map of integration options.

methods.name: setIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Sets the map of integration options.

methods.name: isDefaultSelected
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is marked as default.

methods.name: setDefaultSelected
methods.description: Sets whether the configuration is default.
